name: independent-formats-five-routes-043
selection: Hand-selected expressions for tmux 3.7b, without reading or deriving cases from the RMUX formats registry.
startup:
set-option -s exit-empty off
set-option -g default-shell /usr/bin/bash
set-option -g status off
set-option -g automatic-rename off
new-session -d -s alpha -n zeta -x 40 -y 16 /usr/bin/bash --noprofile --norc -c 'printf "%s\n" "$$" > @ROOT@/main.pid; while IFS= read -r line; do :; done'
set-option -t alpha @nested '#{session_name}:#{pane_index}'
set-environment -t alpha ROUTE043_ENV 'env with spaces'
